cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The treasure map ends at this solid wall. It secretly led us here to wake it. I'm knocking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nothing. And our torch is nearly out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then we were sent to hear it in darkness. I'm putting the torch out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can only hear you breathing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's it. The map was testing our breath control. I'm holding mine.

mechanism: A copies investigative knocking as a ritual, then covers each failed treasure step by announcing and immediately performing a different hidden mission.
confusable: D161 changes the secret goal after failure; D164 keeps the system and discovers a benefit.
comparison: Treasure exploration changes bodily tasks; the radio alternative changes a social performance.
seedUse: Retain the wall, failing light and audible breath as specific causes of each new mission.
